# Abstract

Mike Kerr presents a webinar exploring the historical and scientific roots of Bowen Family Systems Theory. His central purpose is to demonstrate how understanding paradigm shifts in physical science can illuminate the foundations and future trajectory of Bowen theory. Kerr traces the 2,000-year evolution from Aristotle's geocentric model through Aristarchus's underground heliocentric proposal, Ptolemy's epicycle refinements, Copernicus's restoration of heliocentrism, Kepler's laws of elliptical orbits, Galileo's observational astronomy, and Newton's theory of universal gravitation to Einstein's relativity. Throughout this arc, he examines how religious and institutional resistance delayed acceptance of the heliocentric model despite its correctness. Kerr connects this history to Bowen theory by introducing the equation differentiation of self equals emotional objectivity plus action, emphasizing how emotional neutrality enables non-reactive engagement. He argues that broadening perspective from nuclear family through multigenerational systems to evolution and cosmology strengthens emotional objectivity, suggesting that understanding physical-to-biological continuities may deepen comprehension of human differentiation processes.
